purpose: Check whether the public EvoScientist sources provide paper-level reproduction artifacts for arXiv:2603.08127.

checked_sources.name: official_repository
checked_sources.method: fresh shallow clone plus filename and keyword scan
checked_sources.finding: No experiments/ or reproduction/ directory; no public baseline-output, judge-output, human-label, code-execution, or ablation artifact package found.

checked_sources.name: official_repository_readme
checked_sources.finding: The README links the technical report and lists benchmark suite release as roadmap/future work, but does not publish the paper's Table 1/Table 2/Table 3 artifacts.

checked_sources.name: arxiv_paper
checked_sources.finding: The paper reports the 30-query evaluation, seven baselines, Gemini-3-flash judge, human evaluation, code execution success, and ablations, but does not provide downloadable raw outputs or labels.

checked_sources.name: web_search
queries: EvoScientist EvoScientist baseline outputs judge outputs github
EvoScientist AI-Researcher InternAgent Hypogenic Novix K-Dense outputs
checked_sources.finding: Search found the paper, summary pages, official repository, release notes, and baseline project pages, but no public artifact package containing the missing raw experimental outputs.

missing_for_exact_table1_reproduction.pairwise_judge_inputs: 30 queries x 7 baselines x 2 swapped orders = 420 records
missing_for_exact_table1_reproduction.judge_outputs: Gemini-3-flash raw scores for the 420 pairwise records
missing_for_exact_table1_reproduction.paper_matched_evosci_outputs: Full tool-enabled EvoScientist RA/EA/EMA trajectories, not only proposal-only outputs

missing_for_exact_table2_reproduction.human_labels: 3 PhD-level annotator labels and annotation traces for selected baselines
missing_for_exact_table2_reproduction.human_evaluation_inputs: Raw anonymized pairwise prompts shown to annotators

missing_for_exact_table3_and_figure2_rep.ablation_outputs: IDE/IVE/all-removed ablation run outputs and judge records
missing_for_exact_table3_and_figure2_rep.code_execution_logs: Generated code trajectories and execution success/failure logs before and after evolution

current_reproducible_substitute.target_outputs: EvoScientist proposal-only outputs cover 30/30 recovered paper queries.
current_reproducible_substitute.replacement_judge: DeepSeek judge covers 60/60 swapped records for EvoScientist vs Direct-DeepSeek.
current_reproducible_substitute.audit: Replacement-baseline audit is complete; paper-level 420-record audit remains incomplete.

conclusion: As of 2026-06-03, exact paper-level numeric reproduction is not possible from public artifacts alone. The current repository reproduces the software and a stated replacement comparison, and documents the remaining public-artifact gaps required for exact reproduction.
